threadDescriptions.market-speaking: Prepare and practice Spanish conversations at the neighborhood market
threadDescriptions.radio-listening: Build listening comprehension with the fictional Radio Patio recordings
threadDescriptions.bike-repair: Replace the rear brake cable on the commuting bicycle
threadDescriptions.class-refund: Recover payment for a cancelled Spanish evening course

items.text: Spanish market practice: ask for half a kilo, ask the price, then understand the answer without switching languages.
Receipt photo: rear brake cable, 1.6 mm. Bike shop says bring the old housing when collecting.
Radio Patio lesson 12. Heard the numbers but lost the street names. Replay the weather segment at normal speed tomorrow.
Evening Spanish cancelled; Alma's email offers a credit. I paid 84 and want the money returned instead.
Alma corrected my market card: use the polite request first. Keep the stallholder's likely reply on the reverse.
12 / Alma / green one?
items.rationale: Names and number do not identify an objective.

items.text: The cable is fitted but the rear lever still reaches the handlebar. Check tension before riding to work.
Refund form sent with the course receipt. Cancellation date is the 18th, not the 8th as I wrote in my first email.
Radio Patio: the presenter said fourteen, not forty. I copied the transcript too soon; listen blind once before checking it.
Market target update: stop rehearsing half-kilo orders. The stalls sell by the piece here; ask for three tomatoes and two peppers.
items.rationale: Explicit correction to initial speaking plan.

items.text: Call this notebook section Stall conversations now; it used to be Market speaking. Same cards, just a name I will recognize.
items.rationale: Explicit rename of the practice section.

items.text: Alma says accounting approved the 84 refund; allow five working days. Save the message until the bank entry appears.
Practice clip: I order three tomatoes, then pause while the seller answers. Still saying the question as one long word.

Use Patio's produce interview for two exercises: transcribe the seller's prices for listening practice, then turn those replies into my stall-conversation cards. I need both the audio timestamps and the spoken prompts.
items.rationale: Produces listening annotations and speaking materials.

items.text: Rear brake passes the slow driveway test. Trim cable tail and fit an end cap before calling the repair done.
Patio episode 13 has two voices overlapping. Save it for Friday; twelve is now understandable without the transcript.
Ask again on Friday. They may have changed it.
Market debrief: managed the order, but needed the price repeated. Add one short request for repetition to the stall cards.
Bank screenshot: course repayment 84 received. The cancelled evening class claim can be closed.
Patio listening log: street names 4/6 today, numbers 6/6. Next replay without slowing playback.

undo.reason: Hypothetically undo an association based solely on shared teacher Alma; the source documents a refund.
